$comment: Estonian terminology chosen for the Phase 1 prototype. Not yet enforced by validation: this is the agreed vocabulary that translations should follow, and it is what Phase 3/4 glossary checks will be built from.

terms.note: verb form matches the Estonian UI convention of imperative buttons
same word as Continue; Estonian uses one verb for both
"world" in The Sims 4 is the neighbourhood screen: maailm, not ilm
"Sim" stays capitalised as a proper noun in Estonian text too; no case ending is attached to it
Estonian "leibkond" is the standard term for a household unit
kept as a noun phrase so the number can follow the colon

style: Buttons and menu entries are imperative verb phrases (Salvesta, Laadi, Välju), not nouns.
Do not attach Estonian case endings to runtime-inserted names or values; rephrase instead.
Keep English proper nouns that Estonian players know in English (Sim, The Sims 4) rather than inventing translations.
